# Lumiform

> > Lumiform is a mobile-first inspection and audit platform offering digital forms, offline capabilities, and compliance management for workplace safety, quality assurance, and operational excellence.

Lumiform provides iOS and Android apps for field workers to conduct inspections, audits, and risk assessments with support for ISO standards, CAPA compliance, and integrations with automation platforms like Zapier and Power Automate. The platform serves industries requiring safety compliance, quality management, and field service operations.

## Key Topics

- Mobile inspections (iOS/Android)
- Offline data capture
- Compliance tracking (ISO, ISO 19011:2018, CAPA)
- Workplace safety & safety audits
- Digital forms & checklists
- Workflow automation
- Audit software & risk assessment
- Quality management systems
- Field service management
- SSO & SAML 2.0 authentication
- Zapier, Make, Power Automate integrations
- Near miss reporting
- Fire protection & elevator management
- Permit-to-work systems
- Inventory control

## Core Product & Platform

- [Explora la Aplicación Móvil de Lumiform](https://lumiformapp.com/es/producto/aplicacion-movil): Lumiform mobile app for iOS/Android: offline inspections & task mgmt
- [Lumiform Integrations - Connect Your Favorite Software](https://lumiformapp.com/integrations): Lumiform integrations: Zapier, Make, Power Automate, n8n & webhooks
- [Tarifs Lumiform - Comparez Plans, Fonctionnalités & Coûts](https://lumiformapp.com/fr/tarifs): Lumiform pricing: free plan, Pro at €16/user/month with API & webhooks
- [Confianza en Lumiform - Estándares de Seguridad](https://lumiformapp.com/es/confianza): Lumiform security standards: SSO, SAML 2.0, cloud infrastructure & privacy

## Audit & Compliance Software

- [Audit Software by Lumiform](https://lumiformapp.com/app-uses/audit-software): Mobile audit software with ISO/5S templates & offline capability
- [ISO 19011:2018 Software](https://lumiformapp.com/app-uses/iso-19011-2018-software): ISO 19011:2018 compliance software for streamlined audit management
- [Software de Gestión de la Calidad de Lumiform](https://lumiformapp.com/es/necesidades-empresariales/calidad): Quality management software with ISO/CAPA compliance & digital forms
- [Risk Register Software](https://lumiformapp.com/app-uses/risk-register-software): Risk register software with NIST/ISO 31000 compliance & assessment tools

## Safety & Incident Management

- [Inspecciones de seguridad: Software y App de Control | GRATIS](https://lumiformapp.com/es/usos-de-la-app/inspecciones-de-seguridad-gratis): Free safety inspection software with templates & risk management tools
- [Near Miss Reporting Software by Lumiform](https://lumiformapp.com/app-uses/near-miss-reporting-software): Mobile near miss reporting for workplace safety & incident prevention
- [Permit to Work Software by Lumiform](https://lumiformapp.com/app-uses/permit-to-work-software): Digital permit-to-work software for high-risk work authorization
- [Fire Protection Software by Lumiform](https://lumiformapp.com/app-uses/fire-protection-software): Fire safety management: digital inspections & compliance tracking

## Operations & Field Service

- [Work Instructions Software by Lumiform](https://lumiformapp.com/app-uses/work-instructions-software): Digital work instructions software for process management & compliance
- [Field Service Management App](https://lumiformapp.com/app-uses/field-service-management-app): Field service management app with real-time tracking & workflow automation
- [Software de inventario | GRATIS | Lumiform](https://lumiformapp.com/es/usos-de-la-app/software-de-inventario-control): Free inventory control software with automation & retail templates

- [Elevator Management App by Lumiform](https://lumiformapp.com/app-uses/elevator-management-app): Elevator management app: preventive maintenance & compliance tracking
